label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.3… supports Whatever is in act of esse exists at the…
note: ST I q.3 a.4 co. (second proof) states 'esse est actualitas omnis formae vel naturae: non enim bonitas vel humanitas significatur in actu, nisi prout significamus eam esse', and ad 2 that esse in the first sense 'significat actum essendi'. Being in act of esse is thus being. The premise adds the world index: whatever is in act of esse exists at the selected world, which the passage, having no worlds, does not state.
